primary_decision.criterion: fast_race: both geomean and aggregate-ratio lower 95% family-bootstrap bounds exceed 1 against sparse_pr, dense_pr_direct, and radix_pr; correctness also required.

radix_primary_decision.criterion: radix_pr: both geomean and aggregate-ratio lower 95% family-bootstrap bounds exceed 1 against sparse_pr, dense_pr_direct, dense_nearest_both, dense_pr_direct_radix, and dense_pr_nearest_radix; correctness also required.

radix_racing_decision.criterion: fast_race_radix: both geomean and aggregate-ratio lower 95% family-bootstrap bounds exceed 1 against sparse_pr, dense_pr_direct, radix_pr, dense_pr_direct_radix, and dense_pr_nearest_radix; correctness also required.

environment.cpu_clearance: All agent tests, builds and local experiments stopped before this serial paired run. Lightweight document work and status reads may continue. This is an active user Mac, not an isolated CPU; unrelated worker and desktop processes were left running and a sanitized starting ps snapshot is retained. Methods use one thread and seeded randomized order. A separate public Linux CI job at the same frozen source commit is executing the identical comparison.

descriptive_oracle.uncertainty: No confidence intervals computed. This retrospective minimum is descriptive and does not alter any frozen decision.

limitations: The holdout was previously studied in other experiments; it is held out for this new procedure only.
Floating-point containment is numerical, not formal outward rounding.
Retained curve bytes exclude other working arrays; this is not peak memory.
Ratios use paired within-run case medians; values above one favor the named reference. No cross-run or cross-version times are pooled.
Family-cluster CIs describe case variation, not uncertainty from only three timing repetitions; intervals are copied from the bound independent audit.
The fastest eligible PR-only exhaustive comparator is a post-protocol per-case oracle diagnostic. It has no confidence intervals and does not change the frozen decisions.
Benchopt and paired controls compute ROC and PR; matched PR-only controls isolate the extra-work confound.
The 308-series policy holdout belongs to the previously studied corpus and the same families; it is not a new external-domain dataset.
DTAIAnomaly's bounded external appendix is separate. These results do not establish global SOTA.
Retained curve bytes are not peak memory. CPU-clearance notes do not establish operating-system isolation.
